notes.subject: muso min tɛ a ka so-muso ye
notes.rationale: אִשָּׁה זָרָה: 'strange/adulterous woman' vs 'foreign woman' — stranger to the husband or to the covenant

notes.subject: diya da
notes.rationale: הֶחֱלִיקָה 'made smooth' — flattered; the smooth-surface picture of חלק is kept as making words sweet-smooth

notes.subject: i
notes.rationale: direct address to the son/reader, goal of the deliverance begun in verse 12

translation: walasa ⟨i⟩ bɛ bɔ muso min tɛ a ka so-muso ye, min tɛ o jiɲɛ den ye, min y'a ka kumaw diya da.

tokens.gloss: min tɛ a ka so-muso ye
min tɛ o jiɲɛ den ye
